context:
Goal: the waiting page gets written without stalling on an approval nobody sees.
Problem (rule): a change to the shared settings file needs your typed words.
Based on (read): cloud sessions write the page with a tool named ArtifactData, and the settings allow list names only the desktop connector's page tool (read 20:06 CST). A Degen cloud session saw its page writes refused for a policy reason.
Departs from: main's allow list, which names only the connector's page tool — option b adds the cloud tool's name.
Meanwhile: the coordinator goes on; triage runs locally after the restart.
holds: Whether the cloud page tool goes on the shared allow list, or page writes stay in a local session.

options.gain: No settings change, and local page writes are proven.
options.how: Page writes stay in a local session; triage runs locally after the restart.
options.label: Keep page writes local (Recommended)
options.lose: Cloud page writes still stall until someone approves each one.

options.gain: Cloud triage may write the page unattended.
options.how: After the restart, a lane adds the cloud tool's name to the allow list, and one cloud page write proves it. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Allow the cloud page tool
options.lose: One more shared allow entry, which may not take effect.

title: Add the cloud page tool to the settings allow list, as a test?
why: Only your typed words change the shared settings file (measured 2026-11-11, the coordinator's allow-list read at 20:06 CST).
